To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the human vagina contains nerve fibers containing VIP, helospectin, and PACAP.

helospectine and pituitary adenylyl cyclase activating polypetide (PACAP), which are both recently isolated from American lizard saliva and sheep hypothalamus respectively and belong to the same family as vaso active intestinal peptide (VIP) peptide hisidine methionine and glucagon, occur in the human vagina and are co localized with VIP in subpopulations of nerve fibers.

PACAP and helospectin are co expressed with vasoactive intestinal peptide and peptide histidine methioinine, and are present in nerve fibers in close association with the blood vessels and epithelium in the vagina.
